decisions.question: Full archive versus stratified subset?
decisions.suggestion: 64 matrices/dataset, one per document with layer quotas and head balancing

decisions.question: Which common storage budgets?
decisions.suggestion: (2n+1)*[1,2,4], independent of observed errors; same-k reported separately

decisions.question: How to interpret failed positive controls?
decisions.suggestion: Keep error gates unchanged and retain all cases; restrict negative claims

decisions.question: How to estimate the Radon inverse conditioning?
decisions.suggestion: Extremal eigenvalues of R transpose R on causal pixels; 180/360 angles

decisions.question: How to make gradient fitting affordable?
decisions.suggestion: Fused CUDA kernels for exact sparse compact-support rendering; validate against dense values and gradients
